headline: Oarbreaker Flares as Godcrofts and Dead Lands Fall Quiet
war_summary: The map's restlessness has shifted westward since our last edition. Oarbreaker, absent from the previous filing, now leads the dispatches: two base actions within the past two hours at Fort Fogwood, among them a Warden capture, while casualties on both sides have climbed from near silence to more than fifty an hour. Stlican Shelf logged two further actions in the small hours about Fort Hoarfrost and now stands wholly in Warden hands. By contrast, Godcrofts — busiest sheet in the last report, with a dozen actions at Lipsia — and the Dead Lands, where the Salt March churned, have filed no new base movements since late evening, though the Dead Lands' day's losses, some twelve thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden, trail only the Weathered Expanse, where Warden casualties are accelerating past eight hundred an hour. Clahstra, quiet at its bases, has begun bleeding furiously, some nine hundred Colonial and thirteen hundred Warden losses in two hours. Fisherman's Row and Lykos Isle likewise rest. The ledger reads two hundred thirty-six Colonial strategic works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, with one demolished at Godcrofts. This is the hundred-and-seventh day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
